text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Visual-servo helper for this single RoboCasa GR1 episode.
+
+Coordinates supplied on the command line are world-frame grip-site targets.
+Each invocation starts from the robot's last commanded target and records the
+resulting observation; there is intentionally no reset or privileged state.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+T = np.array([2.68282, -2.16303, 0.90053])
+
+
+def to_base(p):
+    q = np.asarray(p) - T
+    return np.array([q[1], -q[0], q[2]])
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument('--right', nargs=3, type=float, metavar=('X', 'Y', 'Z'))
+    ap.add_argument('--left', nargs=3, type=float, metavar=('X', 'Y', 'Z'))
+    ap.add_argument('--rf', nargs=6, type=float)
+    ap.add_argument('--lf', nargs=6, type=float)
+    ap.add_argument('--steps', type=int, default=40)
+    ap.add_argument('--name', required=True)
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+
+    r = Robot()
+    cams = ['egoview', 'robot0_agentview_center', 'robot0_agentview_right',
+            'robot0_eye_in_right_hand']
+    o = r.get_obs(cameras=cams, video='none')
+    prop = dict(zip(o.meta['proprio']['layout'], o.meta['proprio']['now']))
+    start = np.array([prop['cmd_' + k] for k in r.spec()['action_types']['ee_pose']['layout']], dtype=float)
+    goal = start.copy()
+    if args.right:
+        goal[:3] = to_base(args.right)
+    if args.left:
+        goal[6:9] = to_base(args.left)
+    if args.rf:
+        goal[12:18] = args.rf
+    if args.lf:
+        goal[18:24] = args.lf
+    actions = np.linspace(start, goal, args.steps + 1)[1:]
+    res = r.submit('ee_pose', actions, cameras=cams, video='none',
+                   include_depth=True, note=args.name)
+    res.save(str(OUT / args.name))
+    print(json.dumps({'time_left_s': res.meta['time_left_s'],
+                      'control_steps': res.meta['control_steps'],
+                      'start': start.tolist(), 'goal': goal.tolist(),
+                      'eef': {k: v for k, v in zip(res.meta['proprio']['layout'],
+                                                  res.meta['proprio']['now']) if k.startswith('eef_')}}, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
*** End Patch"));
